audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 fits an assassin lane that Viktor still wins 53.14% over 4757 games: she owns level 1 and the 6-plus-first-item window, the middle levels are an even skill fight behind Q shields, and two-item Viktor outscales her single-target burst.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text, whys[1] and mid used the fabricated 'Death Ray' for Viktor's E; spikes[1].text and phases[4].why used 'Chaos Storm' for his R. Spike structure (E at 3, her 6, her first item, your two-item swing) matches the packet chart and is kept.
audit.why: Kit file: E = Hextech Ray (12/11/10/9/8), R = Arcane Storm (120/100/80).

audit.whatIsWrong: Concrete numbers were missing: Distortion is 15s rank 1 with a 4s return window, Ethereal Chains is 14s at 925 range with a 1.5s tether before the root, Mimic is only 45s at rank 1, and her passive Mirror Image triggers below 40% HP. Ten-plus fields also misgendered her as he/his.
audit.why: Kit: LeBlanc W 15/13.75/12.5/11.25/10 dash 600; E 14/13.25/12.5/11.75/11 projectile hardCC 925; R 45/35/25; P invisibility + clone below 40% HP. Chains collide with minions (projectile flag), so lasering from behind the wave denies the root setup.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries 15s/14s/17s; the chain-behind-minions positioning and the 40% passive threshold are stated; lint-flagged pronouns fixed in edited fields.

audit.why: It is the field that must hold real numbers.
audit.corrected: Now carries Distortion 15s, Ethereal Chains 14s, Gravity Field 17s.
